suggestions.principle: breakout winger: stop low on the wall
suggestions.reason: Be stopped at the hash marks, back to the boards, when your D moves it. The pass under forecheck pressure gets shorter and their RW has 7 m to close instead of 4.5.
suggestions.detail: Example suggestion that shows the review format; not real coaching.

suggestions.principle: center: give the winger a short support option
suggestions.reason: With their RW and pinching D closing on the wall, be 4-5 m inside him for a bump pass instead of drifting through the middle.
suggestions.detail: Example suggestion that shows the review format; not real coaching.
